items.title: Can a $25,000 Investment in SoFi Stock Make You a Millionaire?
items.summary: SoFi Technologies, an all-digital bank expanding into crypto, AI investing, and blockchain services, has grown revenue 41% year-over-year but remains down 29% year-to-date. While the stock could reward investors as part of a diversified portfolio, turning $25,000 into $1 million would require a 40-fold increase and a market cap near $10 trillion, which appears highly unlikely.
